# Psalm 104 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 104:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-boundary you-set not they-will-cross; not they-will-return to-cover the-earth.
- **LOGOS:** You set a boundary that they may not pass, so that they might not again cover the earth.
- **PNEUMA:** You drew a line the waters can never cross — they will never flood the earth again.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 104:12 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Above-them birds-of the-heavens dwell; from-between the-branches they-give voice.
- **LOGOS:** Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; they sing among the branches.
- **PNEUMA:** Birds nest along the banks; they sing from the branches.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 104:15 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-wine that-gladdens heart-of man, to-make-shine the-face with-oil, and-bread the-heart-of man sustains.
- **LOGOS:** and wine to gladden the heart of man, oil to make his face shine and bread to strengthen man's heart.
- **PNEUMA:** wine to make their hearts happy, oil to make their faces glow, and bread to give them strength.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 104:21 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** The-young-lions roaring for-the-prey, and-to-seek from-God their-food.
- **LOGOS:** The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from God.
- **PNEUMA:** The young lions roar as they hunt, asking God for their dinner.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Rises the-sun, they-gather, and-to their-dens they-lie-down.
- **LOGOS:** When the sun rises, they steal away and lie down in their dens.
- **PNEUMA:** When the sun comes up, they sneak back to their dens and lie down.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 104:24 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** How many your-works O-YHWH! All-of-them in-wisdom you-have-made; is-full the-earth of-your-possessions.
- **LOGOS:** O LORD, how manifold are your works! In wisdom have you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, the list of things you've made is endless! You made every single one of them with wisdom. The earth is bursting with your creatures.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
